verdict.rationale: Extend ships an official Python SDK (`pip install extend-ai`) and has a dedicated SDKs documentation page. The API surface the SDKs would wrap (parse, extract, classify, split, and sync/async job processing) is documented, but the evidence shows nothing about what the SDKs themselves cover. missing for 10: evidence of an official TypeScript SDK, evidence the SDKs are typed, confirmation that they cover the full API (parse, extract, jobs), documented sensible defaults, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK DX.
